prime_selection: seven spaced good prime-order reductions from an exploratory prime-order screen; exact panel fixed before the full rational-coordinate census, not a random curve/primes sample
coefficient_cap: B=floor(sqrt(q))+2 where q is the frozen prime reduced curve order; enumerate all nonzero (a,b) in [-B,B]^2
candidate_order: ascending Decimal quadratic height score hQQ*a^2+2*hQR*a*b+hRR*b^2, then a,b; point construction follows sorting
relation_event: first nonzero rational aQ+bR reducing to identity, or first two distinct rational candidates with equal nonidentity reduction; derive R/G scalar from coefficient difference and verify it
coverage: stop each prime on coverage of all q-1 nonidentity reduced points or at the full coefficient cap, retaining capped status
work: record first relation and full-coverage candidate indices, cap, distinct reductions, exact rational coordinate bit peak at each stop; cache exact rational aQ+bR only across this structural panel and report unique cache constructions
claim_boundary: selected-prime exact scaling diagnostic on one rational curve, not a general asymptotic law or timed single-target IC/rho comparison
